about.registryInfo: Archblock group structure: Archblock, Inc., a Delaware corporation referenced in Delaware Court of Chancery case An v. Archblock, Inc., and Archblock (Holding) AG, a Swiss company limited by shares (Aktiengesellschaft) registered in Zug under commercial register no. CH-170.3.049.233-2, UID CHE-184.684.864, noted as in liquidation in the Swiss commercial register. Archblock Inc. is cited in third-party analyses as parent of TrueCoin LLC and the broader Archblock platform.
